const body = document.body
tell its meaning

The line:  

```javascript
const body = document.body;
```

**Meaning:**  
- `document` refers to the entire HTML document loaded in the browser.  
- `document.body` specifically refers to the `<body>` element of the document.  
- `const body` creates a constant variable named `body` that stores a reference to the `<body>` element.  

### Usage:  
This allows easy manipulation of the `<body>` element without repeatedly calling `document.body`.  

Example:  
```javascript
const body = document.body;
body.style.backgroundColor = "black"; // Changes the background to black
```
